method.scope: Three prespecified complete first-of-month UTC days within the original Jan–Jun 2021 horizon. Each restarts flat with the archived 2,000 USDT on the exact Binance BTCUSDT 1m/1m backtest setting, 10x host default and the archived order quantity ladder. Conclusions apply to these three cold-start simulations.
method.queue: The exact archived JavaScript runs in the original FMZ simulated-tick broker. A separately emitted no-strategy quote tape verifies economic crossing, first valid tick, full simulated quantity and a 200 ms source observation bracket for every order. The Binance checksum-bearing aggressive trade tape separately tests whether raw signed flow strictly through each native limit could support its full size within the same native posting and fill deadlines. 24 of 25 pass this sensitivity. Historical queue position and the later causal strategy path remain unresolved. These are modeled orders.
method.fees: Every posted limit rested across at least one native order-status observation, then executed at its submitted price. Apply the historically published 0.02% maker rate. Taker schedule 0.04% is configured but unused within the archived strategy path. No fixed spread or synthetic slippage is deducted for these exact limit-price fills. Probe orders are isolated from strategy metrics.
method.settlement: Track long and short separately with the native weighted basis and pro-rata fees and funding for partial reductions. A book-specific source-clock funding control adjusts two modeled January funding marks, while preserving every simulated order and quote. Independent funding schedules and price envelopes validate each debit and credit. Marked P&L and equity drawdown include open long/short positions and fees. Closed win rate counts individual closed reductions, including partial close of a side.
method.proof_limits: The simulated fill price, close quantity and cash are precise to native ledger rounding. No fees or fill outcomes are inferred from physical maker queue estimates.

reproduction: Stage the pinned FMZ and checksummed Binance inputs and run the native worker twice. Run the worker with fund-observe8 and fund-observe16 separately for timestamp controls. Run the recorded-flow checker against the unmodified strategy receipt and verify all generated files using Decimal arithmetic.
